public_rationale: The statement is a broad summary, not one testable claim. In the 10 June 2026 post, 'every bad sign' points to a loose list of items compared with two years earlier: competition, price cuts, staff departures, open-source models, Sora, running costs, reliability and factuality, and profit. The claim does not define this set. Most of the items have no stated measure of 'worse'. Some could look better or worse depending on the measure chosen. 'People are finally noticing' sets no threshold for public attention. Scoring the whole statement would mean choosing measures the claim does not give, so it cannot be judged as a whole.
limitations: No evidence items were gathered, because there is no defined set of signs or measure to test against.
Some listed items might be checkable one at a time, but that would not test the claim that 'every' sign is worse.
This record does not judge whether any single listed sign got better or worse after mid-2024.
